Title: Clara Barton
Content: (`1`) Clara Barton grew up in Massachusetts. (`2`) Her father was a Farmer. (`3`) As a child, she helped care for a brother who was very sick. (`4`) Later she taught school and then worked in government jobs. (`5`) During the Civil War, she took care for wounded soldiers. (`6`) She became known as the Angel of the Battlefield. (`7`) After the war was over, Clara Barton went to Europe. (`8`) And learned about the International Red Cross. (`9`) This organization helps people who are suffering. (`10`) She returned to the United States and worked with others to start the American Red Cross.
